marketLayer.title: US Tech & AI Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: Major US technology leaders report continued year-over-year capital expenditure increases focused on AI hardware, data center expansion, and custom silicon development.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained Capex commitments support semiconductor equipment suppliers and upstream hardware providers, though mega-cap valuations face scrutiny over monetization timelines.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Federal Reserve interest rate trajectory and potential export restrictions on advanced semiconductor technologies.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Internet & Consumer Platforms
marketLayer.fact: Leading HK-listed platform technology companies announced expanded share buyback plans following Q2 earnings reports that showed resilient service sector growth.
marketLayer.inference: Increased capital return efforts help establish a valuation floor for oversold Chinese internet equities while boosting EPS growth prospects.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of domestic mainland consumer spending recovery and ongoing price competition within online retail.

marketLayer.title: Global Macro & Fed Rate Expectations
marketLayer.fact: Recent US labor market data and moderating inflation indicators reinforce market expectations of a gradual policy easing cycle starting later this year.
marketLayer.inference: A stabilizing macroeconomic environment enhances overall risk sentiment, benefiting high-yielding dividend stocks in Hong Kong and global growth equities.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential re-acceleration of headline inflation driven by commodity price volatility or supply chain disruptions.
